title: Use attribute-safe syntax for person-property email merge tags
answers: Why does a person-property merge tag break an email link?
Why does a workflow email send a blank person-property value?
How should the merge-tag menu format property names?
body:
Symptom: Selecting a person property from the workflow email merge-tag menu can break a link, cause a Liquid parse error, or send a blank property value.
Root cause: frontend/src/scenes/hog-functions/email-templater/emailTemplaterLogic.tsx:emailTemplaterLogic emitted double-quoted bracket access; those delimiters terminate double-quoted HTML attributes, and entity-encoded quotes can leave the tag unresolved.
Fix pattern: Use frontend/src/scenes/hog-functions/email-templater/emailTemplaterLogic.tsx:buildPersonPropertyMergeValue: names matching /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/ use dot access; other names use single-quoted brackets, escaping backslashes before apostrophes.
Constraints: Applies to person-property tags generated by the email merge-tag menu, including insertion into double-quoted HTML attributes. Preserve literal property names containing spaces, dots, or a leading $ through bracket access. This emission fix does not repair existing pasted tags or change renderer decoding.
applies: Person-property merge-tag generation in the workflow email templater.
